verdict.rationale: Calendly documents its own Salesforce and HubSpot connections, real-time webhook subscriptions that fire on scheduled, canceled and rescheduled bookings, and integrations that 'fold scheduling into existing workflows'. However, the evidence only shows the CRM connection used for routing lookups, not for writing bookings into the CRM. Pushing booking data into a CRM is described as a custom API use case rather than a native sync. missing for 10: documented native writing of bookings into Salesforce/HubSpot records, any Zapier integration evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of CRM sync.

support.subject: As a sales lead, bookings flow into my CRM and automation stack (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zapier) without manual copying

citations.quote: Automatically look up and match known leads to assigned account owners from Salesforce and HubSpot.
